name: alignment
description: Build a shared, auditable understanding before implementation planning.

interface.shortDescription: Create an approved, traceable project understanding.
interface.longDescription: Guides agents and stakeholders through risk-calibrated discovery, Cockburn use cases, BDD examples, C4 and ADRs, independent review, a read-only decision surface, and an explicit human-gated Superpowers handoff without automatic process ceremony.
defaultPrompt: Use alignment:align-project to establish a shared, evidence-backed understanding of this initiative before implementation planning. Preserve uncertainty and ask one material question at a time.
